recommendation: Keep this source fix. Handle any broader FHIR-14157 modelinfo child-location cleanup as a separate reconciliation rather than expanding this seed beyond the FHIR-32390 rename.
issue_request: FHIR-32390 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request applied for R5 asking to rename Encounter.hospitalization to Encounter.admission because the backbone is about formal admission/stay information across care settings, not just hospitalizations.
initial_application: Commit 8112b8b2fd, merged by b99e0af032, renamed the main Encounter StructureDefinition, Encounter examples, introduction text, and Encounter search parameter source. That application left source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml exposing Encounter.Hospitalization and the Encounter.hospitalization model element.
additional_context: Encounter and Library are active in source/fhir.ini, and publish.ini copies the FHIR ModelInfo content XML into the published build with a link from the Library examples page. The remaining Encounter.hospitalization entries in source/fhir.ini are compatibility mappings and should remain. FHIR-34443 duplicated the same request, FHIR-14157 separately reorganized some former hospitalization children, and FHIR-39148 later clarified the admission definition and is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to rename the FHIR ModelInfo ClassInfo from Encounter.Hospitalization to Encounter.Admission and the Encounter element from hospitalization to admission with type FHIR.Encounter.Admission.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: renamed Encounter.Hospitalization ClassInfo to Encounter.Admission and Encounter.hospitalization model element to admission.

related_jiras.note: Duplicate Jira asking for the same Encounter.hospitalization to Encounter.admission rename.
Broader Encounter reorganization that moved some former hospitalization children; not decided here because it requires separate bounded checking.
Later Published clarification of Encounter.admission semantics; already represented on the combined branch by commit 116bdaec51.
